scope.summary: Complete the W4 source-tool case rework for the object_type work: the already-landed w4_get_source_view_text setup (b206ff40) is confirmed self-contained, and the isolation audit of the other .8.2 object_type cases in source-tools.json found and fixed the same order dependency in w4_get_source_package_body_line_range and w4_get_ddl_package, which read PKG_SRC_<run_id> that only existed because an earlier create_or_replace case had created it; each now owns a setup (CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE + PACKAGE BODY matching the earlier DDL so the get_ddl golden is unchanged) and a matching teardown. The in-lane Rust enum/VIEW/object_types code was already landed in 9a61bbf6/48565243/b206ff40 and is not changed here.
out_of_scope: The in-lane Rust feature code (object_type enums in registry.rs, the get_source VIEW branch in intelligence.rs, the object_types array in dispatch/args.rs and dispatch/mod.rs) was already implemented and committed in 9a61bbf6, 48565243 and b206ff40; this close does not modify it. The w4_get_source_view_text self-contained setup+teardown was likewise already landed by b206ff40.

The 10 remaining order-dependent cases in source-tools.json are NOT .8.2/object_type cases and are left untouched: w4_compile_object_{procedure,function,package,view,trigger,type}_valid, w4_patch_source_{ambiguous_anchor_refused,readonly_refused}, w4_compile_errors_{lists_exact_line_and_text,none_for_valid_object}. They fail only under --case isolation and pass in the full suite; they belong to the compile_object/patch_source/compile_errors beads and are reported as an audit finding, not fixed here.

Other agents' uncommitted edits in this shared checkout (crates/oraclemcp-core/*, crates/oraclemcp-db/src/connection.rs, crates/oraclemcp-db/tests/live_oracle.rs, .github/workflows/ci.yml and scripts/oraclemcp_*_lint.sh) are not this bead's file lane and are excluded from the scoped tree_clean derivation.
The w4_search_objects_object_types_filter case (#41, dictionary-tools.json) already owned its setup and was not changed; it is re-run here only as isolated evidence.
No scheduled CI lane was used: all live proof is manual local-lane execution against the three disposable rig lanes.

limitations: Live proof is manual local-lane execution against the disposable rig lanes free23 (23ai), xe18 (18c) and xe21 (21c) as SYSTEM, driven over the raw MCP stdio and HTTP transports; it is not a scheduled CI lane. Raw artifacts are referenced from integration_evidence and persisted under tests/artifacts/evidence/live/.

The isolated --case runs used the HEAD-context release binary target/release/oraclemcp (sha256 62503ef712a33d25bcacc069a836ef28d553aba4d9f63fb95db14809ce39f4cb) built under the build lease with CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target; the failure mode being fixed is JSON-fixture driven (missing setup -> OBJECT_NOT_FOUND from the tool), so the profile does not affect the verdict.

The named rework case w4_get_source_view_text was already made self-contained by b206ff40; this close confirms it at fddb3710 rather than changing it. The pre-fix OBJECT_NOT_FOUND is reproduced by temporarily restoring that commit's parent state (setup: []) in the working tree, then discarded.

A full-source-tools isolation audit (40 cases, one --case per invocation on free23) leaves 10 non-.8.2 cases failing in isolation because they depend on objects created by earlier cases in the file: w4_compile_object_{procedure,function,package,view,trigger,type}_valid, w4_patch_source_{ambiguous_anchor_refused,readonly_refused}, w4_compile_errors_{lists_exact_line_and_text,none_for_valid_object}. All 10 pass inside the full suite and all 30 other cases (including every get_source/get_ddl object_type case) pass in isolation. Fixing them is outside this bead's .8.2 scope and is reported as an audit finding.
tree_clean is scoped: git status is empty for every in_scope path at fddb3710; the shared checkout carries other agents' uncommitted edits outside this lane.
No Rust source changed here, so no cargo build/test/clippy gate is claimed; the change is a W4 case fixture validated by scripts/e2e/w4/driver.py --selftest (pass) and the live runs above.
follow_ups: The other 10 order-dependent source-tools.json cases listed in limitations would each need their own setup+teardown to pass in --case isolation; they belong to the compile_object/patch_source/compile_errors beads.
